title: Litecoin: Digital Silver with Charlie Lee
description:
Edge CEO Paul Puey caught up with Litecoin creator Charlie Lee at the Litecoin Summit to chat about how Litecoin was designed as a fair alternative to Bitcoin, emphasizing faster transaction times and lower fees. The privacy enhacements brought by the introduction of MimbleWimble, and  Litecoin's interoperability and upcoming developments.

Timestamps:
00:00 The Birth of Litecoin: A Fair Alternative to Bitcoin
03:01 Litecoin's Unique Features and Advantages
05:57 MimbleWimble and Privacy Enhancements in Litecoin
09:09 Interoperability and Future Developments in Litecoin

Links: 
Litecoin - https://litecoin.org/
Charlie Lee on X - https://x.com/SatoshiLite
Edge - https://edge.app
